headline: Russian Weekly Seaborne Crude Exports Rise to Four-Month High of 30.3 Million Barrels
summary: Russian seaborne crude shipments reached 30.27 million barrels across 39 tankers in the week ending November 15. Ukrainian drone strikes on domestic oil refineries diverted more volume toward crude export markets.
why: Russia is one of the world's largest exporters of crude oil.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Increased global seaborne crude supply puts downward pressure on international oil benchmarks.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Crude oil prices fluctuated as higher Russian export volumes offset regional supply disruption risks.
